items.label: VexArchitecture VexBoard Sync Nov 13, 2026
items.purpose: Establish a repeatable VexArchitecture-to-VexBoard sanity-check trajectory that can answer, from each human-facing feature coordinate, whether Screen Lens Surface/Structure/Behavior/Depth preserves the source-proven causal/lived feature slice from intention through semantic ownership and realization, across independently-owned reality and reconciliation, back to human-facing projection—without forcing optional architecture, inventing depth, or letting truthful relationships disappear behind shallow projection.

items.label: Freeze sync baseline and audit contract
items.purpose: Re-ground Vextreme stable-reader architecture, VexLife-Android current source, VexWork current Screen Lens, and open Screen Lens verification work; freeze the end-to-end comparison contract (human intention -> rightful owners/realization -> outside truth -> reconciliation/return -> human projection, with optional relationships remaining optional) and exact initial population before judging gaps.

items.label: Audit every Screen Lens screen and projected pathway
items.purpose: Walk every current Screen Lens screen, interactive control, expression and projected pathway against exact pinned Android source; record where the human-facing feature coordinate enters, what source relationships are already extracted/projected/held, and where causal visibility currently ends, while keeping non-interactive content, legitimate input-only controls and intentionally held localEffect relationships distinct from missing behavior.

items.label: Audit Depth closure and external-participant reflection
items.purpose: Inspect every pathway with Depth—especially Store/repository/provider terminals—and follow current Android source far enough to determine whether the selected feature coordinate lawfully stops there or source proves further realization, relationship, outside-truth, reconciliation/observation, semantic return or human-facing projection. Use VexStream Playback and accepted Partner circuits as witnesses, not universal templates, and classify projector loss separately from truthful terminals.

items.label: Audit Service, Widget and Relay/convergence perception
items.purpose: Pressure the Screen Lens against stable orthogonal/conditional relationships that may not have dedicated Lens roles today: sustained Service-host realization, Widget/other human-surface manifestation, Relay/convergence relationship truth, construction/lifetime, chronology and presentation return. Preserve the question each relationship answers and determine whether existing nodes/edges can expose it before proposing any new role or schema.

items.label: Form only source-proven projection repairs
items.purpose: From accepted audit findings, form the smallest generic VexBoard reader/composition/projection/test corrections needed so source-proven causal neighborhoods remain intelligible from a human-facing feature coordinate through rightful owners and, where source proves it, back through return/presentation. Do not mutate Android meaning for VexBoard convenience, hand-edit generated Lens JSON, add feature-specific mappings, or invent Partner/Relay/Service/Widget semantics by analogy.

items.label: Extract repeatable VexArchitecture ↔ VexBoard sync protocol
items.purpose: Turn the completed audit into a lightweight reusable VexArchitecture ↔ VexBoard sync route: pin architecture/source/Lens coordinates, census feature coordinates/screens/pathways, inspect extraction/composition/projection loss and rightful terminals, preserve source-proven return/human visibility, regenerate/check, and keep proof surfaces claim-specific without creating a second architecture authority.
